transferMechanism.notes: California is not an NLC member, so a California-licensed nurse holds no multistate compact privilege — Florida's simplified 'Multistate License Upgrade' path does not apply; standard MOBILE Endorsement (Fla. Stat. 456.0145) applies instead, the same pathway used regardless of origin state for any non-compact-licensed applicant.

endorsementProcess.value: Apply via the Florida Health Source portal under MOBILE Endorsement (s. 456.0145, Florida Statutes); provide license verification from California via Nursys, complete electronic Livescan fingerprinting (mandatory per 2024's House Bill 975), and pay the applicable fee.
